description: The 3D bar chart illustrates the accuracy of three large language models—Davinci-003, ChatGPT, and BARD—across four distinct logical reasoning categories: Inductive, Abductive, Deductive, and Mix. The vertical axis represents “Accuracy,” scaled from 0 to 0.6 in increments of 0.2, while the horizontal plane displays the models along the y-axis and reasoning types along the x-axis. Each bar is color-coded with a gradient from blue (lower accuracy) to yellow (higher accuracy), though no explicit legend defines the color scale. Visually, BARD shows the highest accuracy in the “Mix” category (approximately 0.6), followed closely by Davinci-003 in “Deductive” (around 0.55) and ChatGPT in “Mix” (also near 0.55). In contrast, ChatGPT exhibits the lowest performance in “Inductive” reasoning (below 0.2), while Davinci-003 and BARD perform moderately in that category (~0.3–0.4). The bars are not sorted by height, and no error bars or statistical annotations are present; the chart emphasizes comparative performance across models and reasoning types through spatial arrangement and color intensity.
